text:
Mike H.: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight edge-proxy pattern instead of a full monolithic gateway. Idea: gRPC between internal services + REST/JSON at the public edge. TL;DR: typed contracts internally, familiar REST for integrators. Thoughts?

Anya P.: +1 for typed internal contracts. My main worry is browser/web clients and 3rd-party integrators that expect plain JSON.

Kevin L.: Have we modeled the extra hop latency with Envoy in front? our 99p SLOs are tight for chat.

Mike H.: Good call. Ballpark is +3-6ms p99 for Envoy + keepalive with our current LB. Persistent connections and http2 reduce overhead.

Nate R.: Protobufs help with schema evolution and guard rails. But service teams hit version skew when gateway and svc expectations diverge.

Anya P.: We could use HTTP transcoding at the edge (envoy grpc_json_transcoder) — single proto source, but still expose REST. Keeps server code gRPC-native.

Kevin L.: Note: transcoder struggles with complex oneof/Any and streaming. For streaming/chat we need bidi gRPC or gRPC-web — transcoder won't cut it.

Mike H.: For streaming endpoints we route directly with gRPC-web or websocket->gRPC bridge. Proposed routing rules prototype:

```yaml
- match: /v1/chat/stream
  route: service-chat
  protocol: grpc
- match: /v1/*
  route: service-api
  protocol: grpc-json-transcode
```

Samira K.: Ops: remember quotas at the edge. Token-bucket keyed by tenant_id + per-route limits. Gateway should emit quota metrics to datadog.

Nate R.: Telemetry: gateway must propagate trace/span ids and add service.version headers. No dropping of baggage. Also surface sampling decision to services.

Kevin L.: On proto lifecycle: propose a shared proto repo with CI lint, compat checks, and generated stubs published to artifact registry. Avoid ad-hoc local copies.

Anya P.: Caveat: generating stubs for every language in a single monorepo will slow CI. Consider domain-scoped proto packages and tag-based consumers.

Mike H.: Next steps: I'll draft an RFC with sequence diagrams, perf numbers, and a small experiment plan: implement gRPC-web + envoy transcode for two non-chat services and measure delta. If no objections, I'll start the branch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch/gateway-edge-proto-eval -> dev :rocket:

Kevin L.: +1 to the experiment. please include perf harness and a smoke test for streaming.

Samira K.: Add quota integr tests & a chaos injection scenario (drop connections) so we can see fallback behavior.

Mike H.: Great — I'll include those in the RFC. Thanks everyone.
